# Lollipop plot of predicted loss-of-function mutations in consensus candidate driver genes
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# Plot predicted LoF-positive samples among Tier 1 common mutated samples.
# Run AFTER the corrected PCGR extraction script. No oncogenicity filter is used.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
})
set.seed(42)

# ---- EDIT THESE PATHS if your output location or extraction date differs ----
BASE_DIR <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/",
  "Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/Driver_Gene_Analysis/",
  "MultiTool_Consensus_29_Genes"
)
EXTRACTION_DATE <- "2026-09-21"
PCGR_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, paste0(
  "MultiTool_Consensus_29_Genes_Tier1_common_PCGR_", EXTRACTION_DATE, ".tsv"))
MAF_AUDIT_FILE <- sub("\\.tsv$", "_MAF_match_audit.tsv", PCGR_FILE)
OUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "LoF_Tier1_common")
RUN_DATE <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
output <- function(suffix) file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0("LoF_Tier1_common_", RUN_DATE, suffix))

if (!file.exists(PCGR_FILE) || !file.exists(MAF_AUDIT_FILE)) {
  stop("Input file missing. Check BASE_DIR and EXTRACTION_DATE; use matched TSV and companion MAF audit.")
}
p <- fread(PCGR_FILE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
m <- fread(MAF_AUDIT_FILE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
require_cols <- function(d, cols, label) {
  missing <- setdiff(cols, names(d))
  if (length(missing)) stop(label, " missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse=", "))
}
require_cols(p, c("Match_key", "LOSS_OF_FUNCTION"), "PCGR")
require_cols(m, c("Match_key", "Hugo_Symbol", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode"), "MAF audit")
if (!nrow(m)) stop("MAF audit is empty.")
if (anyNA(m$Match_key) || anyNA(p$Match_key)) stop("Missing variant matching keys.")
if (!all(p$Match_key %in% m$Match_key)) stop("PCGR file includes variants outside the supplied MAF audit.")

# LOSS_OF_FUNCTION is treated as a binary flag only after inspecting its values.
# Unknown/unrecognized values NEVER become positive just because nonempty.
# If your PCGR version uses other codes, verify their definition before editing.
POSITIVE_VALUES <- c("TRUE", "T", "1", "YES", "Y")
NEGATIVE_VALUES <- c("FALSE", "F", "0", "NO", "N")
MISSING_VALUES <- c("", ".", "NA", "N/A", "NAN", "NULL")
p[, LOF_VALUE := toupper(trimws(as.character(LOSS_OF_FUNCTION)))]
p[LOF_VALUE %in% MISSING_VALUES, LOF_VALUE := NA_character_]
value_audit <- p[, .(Variant_records=.N), by=.(LOSS_OF_FUNCTION, LOF_VALUE)]
print(value_audit)
fwrite(value_audit, output("_annotation_values.tsv"), sep="\t", na="NA")
bad <- setdiff(unique(na.omit(p$LOF_VALUE)), c(POSITIVE_VALUES, NEGATIVE_VALUES))
if (length(bad)) stop("Unrecognized LOSS_OF_FUNCTION values: ", paste(bad, collapse=", "),
                     ". Check annotation_values.tsv and verify encoding before continuing.")
p[, LoF := fifelse(is.na(LOF_VALUE), NA, LOF_VALUE %in% POSITIVE_VALUES)]

# Duplicate PCGR records are collapsed by exact matched variant.
# Conflicting positive/negative annotations require review, not automatic selection.
conflicts <- p[, .(n_states=uniqueN(LoF[!is.na(LoF)])), by=Match_key][n_states > 1L]
if (nrow(conflicts)) {
  fwrite(conflicts, output("_conflicting_annotations.tsv"), sep="\t")
  stop("Conflicting LoF calls for identical variants; review conflicting_annotations.tsv.")
}
variant_calls <- p[, .(LoF=if (all(is.na(LoF))) NA else unique(LoF[!is.na(LoF)])[1]),
                   by=Match_key]
variants <- unique(m[, .(Match_key, Hugo_Symbol, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)])
variants <- merge(variants, variant_calls, by="Match_key", all.x=TRUE, sort=FALSE)

# A sample is positive if ANY retained variant is positive.
# With no positive and at least one unknown variant, its LoF status is unknown.
samples <- variants[, .(
  LoF_positive=any(LoF %in% TRUE),
  Has_unknown_variant=any(is.na(LoF)),
  Retained_variants=.N
), by=.(Hugo_Symbol, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
samples[, LoF_status := fifelse(LoF_positive, "positive",
  fifelse(Has_unknown_variant, "unknown", "negative"))]
summary <- samples[, .(
  Mutated_samples=.N,
  LoF_positive_samples=sum(LoF_status == "positive"),
  LoF_negative_samples=sum(LoF_status == "negative"),
  LoF_unknown_samples=sum(LoF_status == "unknown"),
  Samples_with_any_unknown_variant=sum(Has_unknown_variant)
), by=Hugo_Symbol]
stopifnot(all(summary$LoF_positive_samples + summary$LoF_negative_samples +
              summary$LoF_unknown_samples == summary$Mutated_samples))
# Gene role comes from PCGR gene-level flags, NOT variant ONCOGENICITY.
require_cols(p, c("ONCOGENE", "TUMOR_SUPPRESSOR"), "PCGR gene-role annotations")
parse_role_flag <- function(x, field) {
  v <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  v[v %in% MISSING_VALUES] <- NA_character_
  bad <- setdiff(unique(na.omit(v)), c(POSITIVE_VALUES, NEGATIVE_VALUES))
  if (length(bad)) stop("Unrecognized ", field, " values: ", paste(bad, collapse=", "),
                       ". Verify flag encoding before assigning gene roles.")
  fifelse(is.na(v), NA, v %in% POSITIVE_VALUES)
}
p[, Oncogene_flag := parse_role_flag(ONCOGENE, "ONCOGENE")]
p[, TSG_flag := parse_role_flag(TUMOR_SUPPRESSOR, "TUMOR_SUPPRESSOR")]
# Resolve gene identities through the same MAF matching keys used for LoF counts.
role_rows <- merge(unique(m[, .(Match_key, Hugo_Symbol)]),
                   p[, .(Match_key, Oncogene_flag, TSG_flag)],
                   by="Match_key", all.x=TRUE, allow.cartesian=TRUE)
roles <- role_rows[, .(
  Is_oncogene=any(Oncogene_flag %in% TRUE),
  Is_TSG=any(TSG_flag %in% TRUE),
  Oncogene_flag_conflict=uniqueN(Oncogene_flag[!is.na(Oncogene_flag)]) > 1L,
  TSG_flag_conflict=uniqueN(TSG_flag[!is.na(TSG_flag)]) > 1L,
  Role_annotation_available=any(!is.na(Oncogene_flag) | !is.na(TSG_flag))
), by=Hugo_Symbol]
roles[, Gene_role := fifelse(Is_oncogene & Is_TSG, "Both oncogene and TSG",
  fifelse(Is_TSG, "Tumor suppressor", fifelse(Is_oncogene, "Oncogene", "Other/Unclassified")))]
fwrite(roles, output("_gene_role_audit.tsv"), sep="\t", na="NA")
if (any(roles$Oncogene_flag_conflict | roles$TSG_flag_conflict)) {
  stop("Inconsistent gene-role flags across PCGR records; review gene_role_audit.tsv.")
}
summary <- merge(summary, roles, by="Hugo_Symbol", all.x=TRUE, sort=FALSE)
role_levels <- c("Tumor suppressor", "Oncogene", "Other/Unclassified", "Both oncogene and TSG")
summary[, Gene_role := factor(Gene_role, levels=role_levels)]
role_colours <- c("Tumor suppressor"="#1F77B4", "Oncogene"="#FF7F0E",
                  "Other/Unclassified"="#2CA02C", "Both oncogene and TSG"="#9467BD")
role_shapes <- c("Tumor suppressor"=15, "Oncogene"=17,
                 "Other/Unclassified"=16, "Both oncogene and TSG"=18)

summary[, LoF_percent_of_mutated := 100 * LoF_positive_samples / Mutated_samples]
setorder(summary, -LoF_positive_samples, -Mutated_samples, Hugo_Symbol)
summary[, Label := paste0(LoF_positive_samples, "/", Mutated_samples,
                         fifelse(LoF_unknown_samples > 0, "*", ""))]
fwrite(summary, output("_gene_summary.tsv"), sep="\t", na="NA")
fwrite(samples, output("_sample_audit.tsv"), sep="\t", na="NA")
fwrite(variants, output("_variant_audit.tsv"), sep="\t", na="NA")
cat("\nCDH1 counts (calculated, never hard-coded):\n")
print(summary[Hugo_Symbol == "CDH1"])

# Each gene's marker position is LoF-positive SAMPLE count.
# All markers use the same size; shape and colour indicate PCGR gene role.
summary[, Gene_plot := factor(Hugo_Symbol, levels=rev(Hugo_Symbol))]
unknown_note <- if (any(summary$LoF_unknown_samples > 0)) {
  "* Some mutated samples have unknown LoF status; see sample audit. Positive counts may be incomplete."
} else {
  "Each sample is counted once per gene. LoF status uses the PCGR LOSS_OF_FUNCTION flag."
}
plot <- ggplot(summary, aes(y=Gene_plot)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=0, xend=LoF_positive_samples, yend=Gene_plot),
               colour="#2878A5", linewidth=0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(x=LoF_positive_samples, colour=Gene_role, shape=Gene_role),
             size=4.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(name="PCGR gene role", values=role_colours, drop=TRUE) +
  scale_shape_manual(name="PCGR gene role", values=role_shapes, drop=TRUE) +
  geom_text(aes(x=LoF_positive_samples, label=Label),
            nudge_x=0.6, hjust=0, size=3.6, colour="black") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0, max(summary$LoF_positive_samples)+5),
                     breaks=function(lim) pretty(lim)[pretty(lim) >= 0],
                     expand=expansion(mult=c(0.015,0.02))) +
  labs(title="Predicted loss-of-function mutations in consensus candidate driver genes",
       subtitle=paste0("Candidate driver genes; Tier 1 common variants only\n",
                       "Labels: LoF-positive samples / samples with any retained mutation"),
       x="Samples with at least one predicted LoF mutation (n)", y=NULL,
       caption=unknown_note) +
  theme_classic(base_size=12) +
  theme(text=element_text(colour="black"),
        axis.text=element_text(colour="black"),
        plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=14),
        plot.subtitle=element_text(size=11),
        plot.caption=element_text(hjust=0, size=9),
        panel.grid.major.x=element_line(colour="grey90", linewidth=0.3),
        plot.margin=margin(25,35,25,25), legend.position="bottom")
height <- max(7, 3 + 0.30*nrow(summary))
ggsave(output(".pdf"), plot=plot, width=11, height=height, units="in")
ggsave(output(".png"), plot=plot, width=11, height=height, units="in", dpi=300, bg="white")
cat("\nSaved plot and audit tables to:\n", OUT_DIR, "\n")
# Predicted LoF does not establish biallelic loss or functional validation.
# This figure does not count oncogenic variants or apply LOF_FILTER thresholds.

```
